name: shared-helper-consumers
goal: List a helper only when at least two distinct services, components or functions use that exact helper at the selected commit.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Shared means the exact exported helper is used by at least two distinct active components, services or named functions. Repeated calls, type references, unused imports and barrels do not add consumers.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Previous source-shape coverage distinguished callable exports but deliberately allowed no users. Extend its existing matrix with actual references, aliases, namespaces, shadowing, forwarding, mixed consumer kinds and selected-revision removal; catalog/browser fixtures include zero- and one-consumer helpers.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 979102b4 fails all six actual-consumer matrix cases, shared flags and the three viewport cases: unused and one-consumer exports remain visible. Before screenshots are retained in /tmp/harness-consumers-before.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Committed-source AST references count distinct named function callers and component/service owners, resolving aliases, namespace accesses and forwarding exports. Catalog rows and function Shared badges require two proven consumers of that exact helper; counts are precomputed, not fetched on clicks.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged regression suite passes at f75ca3f2: 7 source metadata cases, 16 Reports unit cases and 3 responsive browser cases. Immutable green record b624ace9399a133bc0211accc8c90c0be9904d925859f42ef8813c0572b8d51e follows red record 7ef79aba10664cbba183fd53f1025ba917684c71abbd0706786f1254338d4b9d.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Scoped verification passes on the implementation retained by 1f26ff4e: Reports check (596 tests, type/lint, builds and audit), 65 entity browser cases, 13 source/documentation/history integration tests, root formatting/type/lint/audit/1295-unit registry validation and CLI/API builds. The follow-up refactor only separates reference-analysis branches and equivalent fixture setup for lint. Formal unchanged red/green remains at 979102b4/f75ca3f2. Live preview 5688 shows 392 qualified helpers; activityReading and acceptInvitation are excluded, activityTime remains and opens its Shared owning entity. Fresh screenshots /tmp/harness-shared-consumers-final.png and /tmp/harness-shared-consumers-detail.png inspected; browser errors/warnings empty. Cold scan approximately 1 second and 407 MiB RSS, not aggregate app memory. Cached helper metadata refreshed from each exact Git commit with backups, preserving unrelated fields, records and media. Full root cross-platform check remains pending: its initial formatting failure was corrected and static checks passed, but the full command was not rerun through native tests under the no-Electron-testing instruction. Main integration remains pending.
